# Active Pressure

## Premise

The harbor commission holds seized letters in a public chest while buyers gather.

## Pressure

The auction opens at sunset, and each bidder wants a different name hidden.

## Actors

- Commission clerk — sells the letters before anyone can reclaim them.

## Discoverable / Affectable

The chest, bidders, clerk, and auction ledger can all be interrupted, copied, exposed, or ignored.

## If Ignored

The sale completes by dusk, and the letters vanish into three private collections.

## Connections

None.
